Features

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Githyanki Parry

    Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 10.

  • Great Weapon Fighting

    When rolling two-handed melee damage, any die rolling 1 or 2 is rerolled once.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Psionic Empowerment

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

Githyanki warriors are a class-like archetype of githyanki characters encountered throughout Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Warriors of the Githyanki are Strength-based Battle Master Fighters.

They are located throughout Crèche Y'llek and are reinforcements in Knights of the Shield Hideout.
